description: Fetch metadata and raw FastQ files from public sequence databases (SRA/ENA/DDBJ/GEO). Given a list of database identifiers — run accessions (SRR/ERR/DRR), experiments, studies, biosamples or GEO series — the pipeline retrieves the ENA run metadata, downloads the FastQ files over FTP, validates every download against its ENA md5 sum, and auto-creates a samplesheet plus sample id-mappings and a MultiQC mappings config, ready for downstream nf-core pipelines such as rnaseq, atacseq or taxprofiler.
name: Fetching public sequencing data: FastQ download, metadata and samplesheets
